name: Memory Kill
desc:
🔫 Memory Kill is an action-packed 1v1 game that combines classic memory matching with chaotic gunplay. 

How to Play:
[ 🪜 ] Climb onto a table
[ ⚔️ ] Start a duel 
[ 🃏 ] Flip and match cards! 

Match cards to grab guns, ammo, and shields, then blast your opponent before they blast you. Each duel tests your memory, agility, and survival instincts.
